scope: Rabat C8 geometry evidence for Douar Doum, El Kora and El Garaa

decisions.reason: The AURS source establishes Douars Doum as a Rabat quartier but provides no directly reusable polygon or complete boundary geometry for the product locality.
The AURS source establishes El Kora as a Rabat quartier but provides no directly reusable polygon or complete boundary geometry for the product locality.
The AURS source establishes El Garaa as a Rabat quartier but provides no directly reusable polygon or complete boundary geometry for the product locality.

guardrails: This verdict concerns the currently certified taxonomy source only; it does not claim that no geometry exists in any other dataset.
No point, centroid, buffer, Voronoi split or name-derived contour is accepted as a polygon.
No administrative boundary is substituted without explicit semantic equivalence proof.
No public map eligibility is changed.
